reader_summary.headline: Mohnish Pabrai shares value investing secrets from his UC Irvine lecture.
reader_summary.overview: Mohnish Pabrai explains how Charlie Munger built wealth by buying undervalued companies and holding them through painful crashes. He advises investors to read widely, stay within their circle of competence, and act decisively only when extreme opportunities appear. The lecture emphasizes patience, honesty, and avoiding debt to let compounding work in your favor.
